 Order

Petitioner/accused No.1 has filed the present petition under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with the case registered in Belagavi City Women P.S Crime No.2/2024.
2.
Parties to the petition are referred with their ranks as assigned in the trial Court for the sake of convenience.
3. Heard the arguments of both sides.

4. After hearing the arguments of both sides and on perusal of the records produced by petitioner and learned HCGP, the following points arise for consideration:
(i) Whether the petitioner is entitled for grant of anticipatory bail in terms of Section 438 of Cr.P.C.?
(ii) What order?
NC: 2024:KHC-D:5291 5.

On careful perusal of the records produced by the petitioner and learned HCGP, it would go to show that on the strength of the complaint filed by victim, criminal law was set into motion by registering the case in Belagavi City Women P.S Crime No.2/2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 342, 504 and 506 R/w Section 34 of Indian Penal Code.

6. The complaint allegations are to the effect that victim had been to Belagavi for her SCC examination and accused No.1 by deceitful means took the victim to the house of accused No.2-Laxmi duplicate police staff in the rented house at Shivaji Nagar, Belagavi.
Accused No.1 by force compelled the victim to stay in the house of accused No.2.
Accused No.1 during night hours in the said house has committed sexual assault on her and wrongly confined her in the house.
The victim was sent to her village on 28.03.2023.

However, accused No.1 on one or the other pretext came to the house of victim in Tamadaddi village of Rabakavi-Banahatti Taluk and on the promise of NC: 2024:KHC-D:5291 providing education, committed sexual assault on her.
On account of such sexual assault, victim was pregnant and she informed the said fact to accused No.1.

However,
accused No.1 with the assistance of accused No.3-Anil Mang ambulance driver, given the pregnancy Rakesh Yashwant Kamble vs The State Of Karnataka on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59131395/
2 test kit through accused No.4-Ningappa Kamble and got confirmed that the victim being pregnant.

sentences.text: Accused No.1 on threat of taking life of victim forced her to take tablet for abortion and she had taken the tablets.
Accused No.1 for 4 months in the said house committed sexual assault on her and during the said period tied Mangalya to the victim in front of photograph of the God.
Accused No.1 has promised that he will convince accused No.5-mother-Madhuravva Yashawant and accused No.6-brother-Ravi Yashwant.
On believing such words, victim remained silent.

Thereafter, through the brother of accused No.1 threatened the victim to take her life and when she had gone police station on 20.11.2023 to file the complaint, accused No.1 stated in the police station that it is family matter and he will amicably settle.
However, accused No.1 did not settle the NC: 2024:KHC-D:5291 issue and disclosed the said fact to the relatives.
Further threatened to put the nude photographs of victim in the social media.
Accused No.1 has also threatened the complainant by keeping her school documents.

On these allegations made in the complaint, the case was registered in Belagavi City,
Women Police station in Crime No.2/2024 for the aforesaid offences and the investigation is in progress.
7. The records produced by the learned HCGP would go to show that accused No.1 was working as a Police constable in City Armed Police (C.A.R Police).
The leave particular of accused No.1 obtained by investigation officer would go to show that since from 21.12.2023 accused No.1 is on medical leave.

Learned counsel for accused No.1 during arguments submitted that the other accused named in the FIR have already been granted anticipatory bail by the Sessions Court in Crl.Misc.No.99/2024 and Crl.Misc.No.123/2024 by order NC: 2024:KHC-D:5291 dated 06.02.2024.
However, the anticipatory bail application of accused No.1 alone came to be rejected.
8. In the present case, victim herself has filed complaint alleging that she was subjected to sexual intercourse against her will and under threat.

The victim has also given her statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. before the learned Magistrate by reiterating the allegations made in the complaint that accused committed penetrative sexual assault against her in spite of resistance and threatening to take away her life.

9. On careful reading of complaint allegations and statement of victim before Magistrate, the circumstances narrated by the victim would never leave any indication that victim was consenting party for sexual intercourse.
The medical evidence would reveal that victim was more than 20 years and she has stated her age as 30 years in the complaint.
Hymen was found to be not intact and old tear noted with no injuries and bleedings.
There was no physical violence on the victim.
There is prima facie NC: 2024:KHC-D:5291 evidence at this stage to hold that victim was subjected to sexual intercourse.
The statement of the victim reveals that accused No.1 has committed sexual assault on her.
Indisputably accused is working as Police constable in CAR, Belagavi.
He forced the victim to stay in house of accused No.2 in Shivaji Nagar when she had come to Belagavi for SCC examination.
Accused No.1 and 2 were unknown to the victim prior to the incident.
Accused No.1 by taking advantage of circumstances of victim being not in a position to seek any help has committed sexual assault on her.
The investigation in this case is still in progress and the interrogation of accused No.1 is necessary to unravel the truth.

Consequently, proceed to pass the following:
NC: 2024:KHC-D:5291 ORDER
The bail petition filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. is hereby rejected.
